title: Euclid: 500 candidate strong gravitational lenses
summary: The first catalog of 500 candidate galaxy–galaxy lenses, almost all previously unknown, was selected with AI models and then reviewed by citizen scientists and experts. These are candidates, not confirmed lenses; 7,000 by the late-2026 release and about 100,000 by mission end are projections.

evidence.tested: AI candidates were inspected by citizen scientists and then vetted and modelled by experts, system by system, to produce 497 candidate lenses in the first catalogue.
evidence.unknown: The page calls these candidates, not confirmed lenses, gives no error or false-positive rates, and the future counts are projections.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning models performed the initial sweep for candidate lenses.
